nav.announcement: Shark Tank India mein dekha gaya · Season 2 · Amit Jain & SucSEED ka support

hero.subtext: Zyaadatar users 24 ghante ke andar apna pehla rupaya kamate hain. Yahan bataya gaya hai yeh step by step kaise hota hai.

step1.title: Download karo & sign up karo
step1.description: Android par Funngro app download karo. OTP se verify karo aur apni UPI ID add karo. Bas itna hi chahiye real brand campaigns se kamana shuru karne ke liye. Hamesha free.

step2.title: Brand campaign chuno
step2.description: India ke sabse bade brands ke campaigns dekho. Jo pasand aaye woh chuno — influencer briefs, product sampling, referrals, ya surveys. Har campaign shuru karne se pehle exact pay dikhata hai.

step3.title: Kaam karo
step3.description: Apni convenience par campaign complete karo. Social media par post karo, doston ke saath share karo, product try karo, ya survey bharo.

step4.title: UPI mein paise pao
step4.description: Approve hone ke baad, paisa seconds mein UPI mein aa jaata hai. Zero fees. Koi minimum balance nahi. Pehli baar ke users typically 24 ghante mein pehla rupaya dekhte hain.

step5.title: Apni ladder badhao
step5.description: Har campaign zyaada paying opportunities kholti hai. Starter se Grower se Builder tak level up karo. Top earners apna Clan lead karte hain.
